title: AI Tool-Use Policy (Tiered: Local / Grok-ZDR / Never)
reference_docs: ITAR 22 CFR 120-130 (USML Category IV — launch vehicles & rocket engines, incl. RDRE technical data); EAR 15 CFR 730-774; DFARS 252.204-7012 (CUI safeguarding, NIST SP 800-171); Exos Export-Control Screening (itar_ear_screen); Exos CUI Policies & Procedures (SEC-CUI); xAI/SpaceXAI Zero Data Retention (ZDR) enterprise documentation.
remarks: Approved under the authority of John Quinn, Cofounder & CEO. Bright-line, tiered rule so personnel do not have to judgment-call each prompt. Reflects the Feb 2, 2026 SpaceX acquisition of xAI (Grok is now a SpaceX product) and the availability of enterprise Zero Data Retention. Grok is NOT FedRAMP-authorized as of this revision — no federal/CUI data path. Reassess if xAI achieves FedRAMP High with no-train guarantees.
objective: establish a bright-line, tiered rule for which AI tool Exos personnel may use for a given task — so that export-controlled technical data (ITAR/EAR), CUI, and competitively sensitive information are never exposed to an external AI service, while still letting the team use commercial AI (Grok) for genuine non-sensitive work
overview: The export-control risk of AI is not 'using an AI to help design a rocket' — it is the specific DATA placed into a prompt. Transmitting USML Category IV technical data (Exos's specific engine/vehicle designs, dimensions, performance figures, test data, drawings, or GNC internals) to an external service is a potential export; asking a model for general physics, public-literature synthesis, math, or non-controlled coding is not. This policy sorts every AI task into one of three tiers based on WHAT the prompt contains. When in doubt, a prompt drops to the more restrictive tier. Tier 1 (Local) is the vault; Tier 2 (Grok-ZDR) is the external non-controlled tier under strict conditions; Tier 3 is never. The Exos local Ollama stack (zero data egress) is always an acceptable substitute for any task.

tasks.name: Task 1 - Classify the prompt BEFORE you send it
steps: Ask: does this prompt contain any export-controlled technical data (ITAR USML Category IV — rocket engines, launch/suborbital vehicles, RDRE; or EAR-controlled data)? If yes -> Tier 1 (Local only).
Ask: does it contain CUI, NDA-covered material, or anything marked proprietary/controlled? If yes -> Tier 1 (Local only).
Ask: does it contain Exos business-development, strategy, capital/financial, cap-table, customer, or competitive information? If yes -> Tier 1 (Local only).
Ask: does it contain personnel/HR/PII data? If yes -> Tier 1 (Local only).
If NONE of the above apply and the content is general, public, or non-controlled -> Tier 2 (Grok-ZDR) is permitted.
_____ When uncertain whether data is controlled, DEFAULT DOWN to Tier 1 (Local) and, if needed, request an export determination per Task 5. Do not guess upward.

tasks.name: Task 2 - TIER 1 (LOCAL ONLY): the vault - zero egress
steps: Use ONLY the Exos local model stack (Ollama on Exos-controlled machines, Mac Studio primary) for anything in this tier. No external AI service, ever.

Tier 1 covers: specific RDRE / engine / vehicle designs, geometry, dimensions, injector/chamber details, performance parameters, GNC internals, test data, drawings, and manufacturing know-how (USML Category IV technical data).
Tier 1 also covers: CUI and DFARS-safeguarded data; NDA-covered third-party material; BD/strategy/capital/financial/competitive material; customer-identifying information; personnel/HR/PII.
_____ Confirm the model you are using is the local stack (zero egress) and not a cloud endpoint before entering Tier 1 content.
_____ If a Tier 1 task exceeds local-model capability, escalate per Task 5 — do NOT move the data to an external tool to get a better answer.

tasks.name: Task 3 - TIER 2 (GROK-ZDR): external non-controlled tier - conditions REQUIRED
steps: Permitted uses ONLY: general engineering physics and detonation-wave theory from public literature; math and sanity-checks; synthesis of public information; drafting/formatting of non-sensitive text; coding on non-controlled, non-proprietary code.
_____ Use the xAI/SpaceXAI ENTERPRISE API with Zero Data Retention (ZDR) ENABLED at the team level. Verify the 'x-zero-data-retention' response header is present.

_____ NEVER use consumer Grok or the Grok Build CLI for Exos work — a July 2026 wire-level audit showed the consumer Grok Build agent uploading entire code repositories and history, including files it was told to ignore. API + ZDR only.
_____ Do NOT upload repositories, file trees, or codebases. Paste only the specific non-controlled snippet needed.
_____ Run the scope through Exos export screening (itar_ear_screen) if there is any question that the topic borders controlled technology.
Remember: even under ZDR, Grok is a SpaceX-owned product (xAI acquired by SpaceX Feb 2, 2026). Keep all competitive/BD/strategy content OUT regardless of ZDR — that is a Tier 1 item.
_____ Observe budget caps and log usage per the Exos AI cost-tier controls.

tasks.name: Task 4 - TIER 3 (NEVER): absolute prohibitions
steps: NEVER transmit ITAR/EAR-controlled technical data, CUI, or NDA-covered material to ANY external AI service (Grok or otherwise), with or without ZDR.
NEVER route federal or CUI data through Grok — xAI is NOT FedRAMP-authorized as of this revision; there is no compliant government/CUI data path.
NEVER use consumer Grok / Grok Build CLI on Exos machines or repositories.
NEVER feed Exos BD, strategy, capital, or competitive information to xAI/SpaceXAI.
_____ Any exception to a Tier 3 prohibition requires written approval from the CEO and the Empowered Official — no self-authorization.

tasks.name: Task 5 - When unsure: escalate for an export determination
steps: If you cannot confidently classify a prompt, hold it in Tier 1 (Local) and request a determination before using any external tool.
_____ Route the export/classification question to the Exos Empowered Official (export control) via the DD -> Dossier -> TDTCA -> EO release workflow.
_____ Do not proceed with an external tool until the determination is returned and logged.

tasks.name: Task 6 - Reassessment triggers
steps: Reassess this policy if xAI/SpaceXAI achieves FedRAMP High authorization WITH no-train / data-residency guarantees — that could open a controlled-data path and would change Tier 3.
Reassess on any change to Exos's export posture, the local model stack, or the availability/behavior of enterprise ZDR.
_____ Record any reassessment as a new revision of this procedure through the procedure generator (never edit the controlled doc by hand).
